title: Contents Packout & Storage Customer-Billed Vault Storage
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy prices the vault storage line of a storage period billed to the customer on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job, and only such a line: a period is billed to the customer when the job is self-pay or when the period's first day falls after the approved storage end date on the linked claim file. Every other storage line, including every period billed to the insurance claim and every climate vault, oversized item and declared-value coverage line, remains under the base storage rule. The line is billed to customer.

## When a period is customer-billed

| Job on Partial or Full Contents Packout | First day of the storage period | Line priced under this policy? |
|---|---|---|
| self-pay | any | yes |
| insurance-funded | after the approved storage end date on the linked claim file | yes |
| insurance-funded | on or before the approved storage end date | no; billed to the insurance claim under the base storage rule |
| any | climate vault, oversized item or declared-value coverage line | no; base storage rule |

**Boundary (abstract dates).** On an insurance-funded job, a period whose first day is the day after the approved storage end date is customer-billed; a period whose first day is that end date itself is not.

## Booking the line: `charge_customer_vault_storage_2f9c3128`

**Capability.** The tool books the vault storage line of one storage period on a contents job, billed to the customer: it adds one vault storage charge for the storage period that begins on the given first day to the named contents job, billed to customer, and raises the job's balance due by the same amount. The customer can see the new storage line and the higher balance on the job straight away. A second call for the same job, period and amount books nothing new: it returns status `already_booked` with that line's id and leaves the balance due unchanged.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_customer_vault_storage_2f9c3128` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job the storage line belongs to, as returned by the contents job lookup | identifier |
| `claim_file_id` | the reference number of the insurance claim file the contents job is billed under, as shown on the contents job record; echoed on the receipt | identifier; an empty string for a self-pay job, which has none |
| `storage_period_start` | the first day of the storage period the line covers | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |
| `amount` | the line amount in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (booked when the line was added), `contents_charge_id` (reference number of the new storage line), `contents_job_id`, `claim_file_id` (empty for a self-pay job), `storage_period_start`, `bill_to` (always customer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the job's balance due after the line, USD, 2 decimal places). For a repeated call with the same job, period and amount the receipt carries status `already_booked`, the existing line's `contents_charge_id`, `contents_job_id`, `amount` and the unchanged `balance_due`.

**Errors.** "storage_period_start must be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD." when the date is not in that form; "amount must be a positive USD figure." when the amount is zero or negative.
